familyDefinition: 54 LLN prefix events plus 30 whole-CDF CLT events; one DKW event covers every predeclared grid point in a CLT case. No independence between checks is assumed for the union bound.

llnBands.uniform: Hoeffding two-sided bound for the mean of ideal U(0,1), clipped to its support
llnBands.exponential: Equal-tail Gamma(n, scale=1/n) model quantiles for the mean of n ideal rate-one Exponentials

cltBand: Two-sided DKW-Massart epsilon=sqrt(log(2/deltaPerEvent)/(2*repetitions)); compare the complete histogram CDF on the declared edges with an independent ideal finite-n model CDF. Record distance to Phi separately; it need not pass the normal-null band at small n.
oracle: SciPy normal, Gamma and Irwin-Hall CDFs/quantiles; no simulation-engine imports in the oracle generator
expectedPatterns: LLN checkpoints are successive prefixes of one stream, not independent sample means.
A running-mean error can increase between checkpoints; no monotonic path-error assertion is allowed.
CLT replicates use distinct replicate-indexed streams. n=1 Exponential remains visibly nonnormal; the default n=64 case should have a smaller grid distance to Phi than n=1.
A histogram-CDF grid distance is not the full Kolmogorov supremum. Preserve underflow and overflow mass.
The fixture mixer is provisional. Probability bounds describe ideal iid models and are conditional diagnostics for these deterministic streams, not PRNG certification.
selectionRationale: Seeds are the existing #14 benchmark and uint32 endpoints. The grids and thresholds are fixed before generating this study's outputs; n=32 retains the #14 CLT benchmark. Keep any failed diagnostic visible rather than changing a seed or tolerance.
